output.reason: I find this convincing. The resin × dryer interaction explains everything I've seen: why the trial passed (it ran only on Press 7), why D5 looked fine on Quillan, why second shift has the higher reject rate, and why the reject codes are moisture-type. The test that dried the same lot in a portable dryer is strong proof, and this week's actions are concrete, though the brief should have said whether second shift running all its VX on Press 5 is a confirmed fact.
